story_overview: In a cluttered study, a tense meeting between Marcus, Sofia, Daniel, Nico, Omar, and Raj escalates when Marcus suddenly draws a pistol on Raj. The group's activities continue across various city locations, including a back-alley kitchen and a convenience store, as they deal with the fallout of the confrontation and a mysterious wooden box.

Marcus: Man with a full, neatly-trimmed brown beard and short brown hair, wearing a dark navy casual blazer over an unbuttoned light-gray collared shirt.
Sofia: Woman with dark hair styled in a ponytail, wearing a white jacket.
Nico: Man in a black and white zip-up tracksuit jacket.
Daniel: Man wearing a dark blue suit jacket over a white shirt with a subtle pattern.
Raj: Man in a patterned long-sleeve polo shirt.
Omar: Man wearing a grey and black striped collared shirt.
The Cluttered Study: Office interior with dark wood-paneled walls, featuring a large desk and built-in bookshelves overflowing with stacks of papers, books, and file folders.
the black pistol: Modern semi-automatic pistol with a matte black polymer body and a dark metallic steel slide.

In The Cluttered Study, Marcus, Sofia, Daniel, Nico, Omar, and Raj are gathered around a desk for a tense meeting. As Raj speaks to the group, Marcus abruptly draws the black pistol and aims it directly at him. Nearby, Sofia raises a hand wearing the single glove as the others watch in shock.
